plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, Child Development B.S. program page, 'General Elective Option' 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid), Total Hours 120. All semester sums reconcile with printed Hours (15+15+16+15+14+15+15+15=120). STALE GE LETTERING: this roadmap uses the pre-2025 GE pattern (A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, B4, C, C1, C2, D, D1, E, F, B5, C3, D3) though the 2025-2026 catalog otherwise uses the new lettering — kept verbatim as printed and documented. Statistics requirement is a choice (MAT 131 / MAT 132 / MAT 134 / PSY 230) sequenced at the lower-bound 3 units of the printed 3-4 range. 'CDV Foundational Core (CDV 325, CDV 330, or CDV 325)' lists CDV 325 twice — a genuine catalog duplication kept verbatim; modeled as a CDV 325 choice slot. 'CDV Specialized Elective' slots reference the roadmap footnotes: complete five from CDV 342, 344, 370, 372, 423, 440, 442, 444, 450, 462, with one capstone (CDV 480, 490, 492, 496, 498) permitted as a specialized elective. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
